20th People's Majlis

People's Majlis

People's Majlis Committee Minutes

12th Meeting of the Petition Committee

14 October 2026

Venue: Building A of the People's Majlis (Committee Room 6)

Start time: 20:53

{Chaired by the Committee Chair; Member for Gadhdhoo constituency Mohamed Ali}

Remarks by the Chair:

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Welcome to all honourable members to the 12th meeting of the Petition Committee. Taking part in today's meeting are the honourable Member for Dhidhdhoo constituency Abdul Latheef Mohamed, the honourable Member for Ungoofaaru constituency Ibrahim Shifaz, the honourable Member for Hinnavaru constituency Mohamed Abdul Rahman, and the honourable Member for Vaikaradhoo constituency Hussain Ziyad. The matter now before the committee is a petition that has received signatures reaching threshold one. It is a petition we have received calling on the Majlis to proceed with, and decide on, the resolution submitted to the Majlis calling on the government to formulate a general policy on grooming and dress for employees working in the tourism industry. So I will open the floor on what is now in this petition, for all honourable members to speak on it as they see fit. The main solution sought here is: in order to bring a quick solution to the policies currently formulated on grooming and dress of employees working in the tourism industry at tourist resorts, hotels and some other places doing tourism business, to instruct the relevant government offices to put in place sound policies so that male employees working in this industry can keep beards and moustaches, and on the obstacles to female employees doing their jobs while wearing the hijab, and for the Majlis also to decide on this. So this is the solution that the party who submitted this petition wants from us. So I will open the floor to honourable members. I give the floor to the honourable Member for Vaikaradhoo constituency Hussain Ziyad.

Remarks by the Member for Vaikaradhoo constituency Hussain Ziyad:

Yes! Thank you, Chair. We, this matter is a matter that is still before a committee in the Majlis at this time. As I see it, a resolution has also been submitted to move towards the solution they want in this matter. It is for that committee to make a decision on it. Instead of this

committee also deciding and instructing ministries to do a particular thing, I do not see it as something that can be instructed. I believe we could request that committee to speed this up and to obtain information on this matter. But; however, looking at the number of members in the committee at this time, there are not enough members present to make a decision. So I do not think we can proceed with this matter. That is my view.

Remarks by the Chair:

Thank you. Next I give the floor to the honourable Member for Dhidhdhoo constituency Abdul Latheef Mohamed.

Remarks by the Member for Dhidhdhoo constituency Abdul Latheef Mohamed:

Thank you, honourable Chair. As the honourable Member for Vaikaradhoo constituency Hussain Ziyad just said, looking at deciding this matter in the committee at this time, some of our honourable members are not present, perhaps because it is a holiday. And as I recall, this matter is now in the Finance Committee or perhaps the Economic Committee; this matter is still ongoing in the Economic Committee. So even though this committee has not yet decided one way or another, I believe this matter is one this committee must look into when it receives a petition; it can be looked into. I believe it is a matter that should be looked into. So for this, we should send to the Economic Committee, or have them send to us, how far it has now got, why it had to be parked, whether any work is being done on it, whether any work is under way through talks with the tourism office or other relevant offices, and how long it will take to finish. Having finished, that decision will be made on the petition now submitted. Whether we can fulfil the things they are asking for in this matter. If it can be done, how far it can be done. I think we should send letters to our committee, to these two committees. And also related to this

is the ministry for the tourism sector. If information on this needs to be obtained from the ministry for the tourism sector as well, obtain it and bring that information, and then at a following meeting we discuss this more broadly; or else I think it should be settled that way. That is how things should go.

Remarks by the Chair:

Thank you. Although we have proposals, since our voting quorum is not met at this time, at a following committee meeting we will send the letters to the various places and make the requests for information. So, with no other business, I will end tonight's 12th meeting of the Petition Committee here. And peace be upon you.
